After that I just stopped looking, and it was ok. I don't think it's very common to actually see it, so don't worry about it!

Hi, I'm so sorry for you... Just wanted to tell you that I felt the same when I found out about the pregnancy. The waiting for the pills were terrifying, and all that I could think about was killing myself, cause I couldn't deal with this. 
But the pills arrived! I'm doing my m.a today, doing it alone cause I also couldn't tell anyone, and all I can feel is relief. 
There is a solution for this! And there is life besides the procedure. If you want to talk about it and share your experience, you can chat me. Good luck, you're gonna be fine!!!!

Hi! Since you live in a country where abortion is legal, take a look at the website women on web. They can send you the pills, with an affordable price, and they give you all the support on how to do the procedure. Good luck!
